description: Make the stdlib-only Python container serve the baked SPA while keeping the JSON API byte-for-byte, and convert the Dockerfile to a multi-stage build (node build stage -> python:3.12-slim runtime). Depends on FEAT-001 (the SPA sources + architecture.svg must exist under container/). Preserves the ALB 'GET /' 200 health check (now HTML 200), container name 'web', PORT 8080, POINTS_PER_DOLLAR, and compute_points behavior.
steps: Read plan.md and context.json FIRST. Confirm FEAT-001 produced container/frontend/ and container/architecture.svg.

Modify /Users/erictole/demo/apcr-dva/.worktrees/frontend/demo/session4-coffee-ship/container/app.py: add a module-level APP_VERSION constant (string). Add a STATIC_DIR = os.environ.get('STATIC_DIR','/app/static'). Keep POINTS_PER_DOLLAR, PORT, compute_points EXACTLY as today.

In app.py do_GET routing (keep do_POST /order unchanged in shape): GET /health -> JSON {"status":"ok","version":APP_VERSION} 200; GET|POST /order -> unchanged loyalty JSON via compute_points (same keys orderId/points, same 400 handling); GET / -> serve STATIC_DIR/index.html as text/html 200 (preserves ALB health check); GET /architecture.svg -> STATIC_DIR/architecture.svg as image/svg+xml; GET /assets/... and other existing static files -> serve with Content-Type from mimetypes.guess_type; unknown path whose last segment contains a '.' (asset-looking) and not found -> 404 JSON/empty; any other unknown non-API path -> SPA fallback: serve index.html 200. Guard against path traversal by resolving the requested path under STATIC_DIR and rejecting anything that escapes it. Keep stdout log_message.
Keep the container stdlib-only: do NOT add any import that is not in the Python 3.12 standard library (os, json, mimetypes, pathlib/os.path, http.server are fine). requirements.txt stays empty.

Modify /Users/erictole/demo/apcr-dva/.worktrees/frontend/demo/session4-coffee-ship/container/Dockerfile to multi-stage: STAGE 1 FROM node:20-alpine, WORKDIR /build, COPY frontend/package*.json ./, RUN npm ci, COPY frontend/ ./, RUN npm run build (produces /build/dist). STAGE 2 FROM python:3.12-slim, WORKDIR /app, COPY requirements.txt ./, COPY app.py ./, COPY --from=0 /build/dist /app/static, COPY architecture.svg /app/static/architecture.svg, ENV PORT=8080, EXPOSE 8080, CMD ["python","app.py"]. Add a header comment documenting the container/-rooted layout (frontend/ and architecture.svg live inside the build context).
Verify the build context assumption holds: docker build context is container/, so frontend/ and architecture.svg are reachable by the COPY lines.
acceptance_criteria: Running the app with STATIC_DIR pointed at a built dist: GET / returns text/html 200; GET /health returns {"status":"ok","version":...} 200; POST /order {"orderId":"t1","total":12.5} returns {"orderId":"t1","points":120} 200; GET /order returns sample loyalty JSON 200; GET /architecture.svg returns Content-Type image/svg+xml 200; GET /nope.js returns 404; GET /some/spa/route returns text/html 200.
docker build -t coffee-ship:feat002 container/ (from session4-coffee-ship) succeeds and the running image answers the same curls.
app.py imports are stdlib-only; requirements.txt remains empty; container name/behavior unchanged (no change to /order response shape).
verification: cd /Users/erictole/demo/apcr-dva/.worktrees/frontend/demo/session4-coffee-ship && docker build -t coffee-ship:feat002 container/ && docker run --rm -d -p 8080:8080 --name cs002 coffee-ship:feat002 && sleep 2 && curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} %{content_type}\n' http://localhost:8080/ && curl -s http://localhost:8080/health && curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8080/order -d '{"orderId":"t1","total":12.5}'; docker rm -f cs002; docker image rm coffee-ship:feat002
findings: Implemented. container/app.py now serves the baked SPA from STATIC_DIR (default /app/static) while keeping the JSON API byte-for-byte: added APP_VERSION='v1' and STATIC_DIR; POINTS_PER_DOLLAR/PORT/compute_points unchanged. Routing: GET /health -> {"status":"ok","version":APP_VERSION} 200; GET|POST /order unchanged (self.path.startswith('/order'), same orderId/points keys, same 400 handling); GET / -> index.html text/html 200 (preserves ALB health check), with a tiny placeholder fallback if dist isn't baked so '/' is always 200; GET /architecture.svg -> image/svg+xml; other static files -> Content-Type via mimetypes.guess_type (fallback application/octet-stream); unknown asset-looking path (dot in last segment) -> 404 JSON; other unknown non-API path -> SPA fallback to index.html 200. Path traversal guarded via os.path.realpath confined under STATIC_DIR (verified /../app.py -> 404). Query/fragment stripped before routing. stdlib-only (added only 'mimetypes'); requirements.txt still comment-only/empty. Dockerfile converted to multi-stage: stage 'build' node:20-alpine runs npm ci + npm run build -> /build/dist; stage python:3.12-slim copies requirements.txt, app.py, --from=build /build/dist -> /app/static, and architecture.svg -> /app/static/architecture.svg; ENV PORT=8080, EXPOSE 8080, CMD python app.py; header comment documents the container/-rooted build context. Container name 'web' unchanged (not touched here). VERIFIED: py_compile ok; local run (STATIC_DIR=dist) GET / 200 html, /health version json, POST /order {total:12.5} -> {points:120}, GET /order sample json, /nope.js 404, /some/spa/route html 200, /assets/*.css text/css 200, traversal 404; composed-static-dir run gave /architecture.svg image/svg+xml 200; docker build -t coffee-ship:feat002 container/ succeeded (one transient 'content digest not found' pulling python:3.12-slim, fixed by docker pull python:3.12-slim then rebuild) and the running image answered all curls identically incl. /architecture.svg image/svg+xml 200. Temp container+image removed; __pycache__ cleaned. No change to /order response shape or the /-200 health contract, so no warning raised. Did not touch infra/ or app/.
